# device42_auto_discovery_nmap (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_auto_discovery_nmap" "example" {
  name           = "example"
  server         = "hostname.domain.local"
  target         = "192.168.1.0/24"
  schedule_time  = "02:00"
  schedule_days  = "0,2,4"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the nmap autodiscovery job. Create only (the API upserts by name).

### Optional

- `end_ip` (String) End of the IP address range.
- `exclude_servers` (String) Comma separated list of addresses to exclude.
- `schedule_days` (String) Comma separated days of week (Monday = 0).
- `schedule_time` (String) Time in HH:MM format to schedule the job.
- `server` (String) IP or FQDN of the target server.
- `start_ip` (String) Start of the IP address range.
- `tags` (String) Comma separated list of tags to attach.
- `target` (String) Target to scan (network, hosts, or CIDR range).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
